rationale: FX02 flags fair_value_currency because the extracted unit value is U_USD rather than the literal USD. The raw SOI table shows the fair value column is dollar-denominated, including dollar signs on the position line and schedule total, and a targeted source search found no U_USD text in the filing tables. This supports that U_USD is a USD unit-id/normalization artifact, not evidence of a non-USD fair value.
